archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) mixed with Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) for clean, minimalist food-photography-forward UI.
design_philosophy: Dark cinematic mode to make food photography pop. Minimalist layout with clear visual hierarchy, utilizing the category color coding for navigation and tagging.

layout.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6 to p-8 inside cards. Content should have pb-24 to avoid bottom nav overlap.
layout.grids: Control Room Grid for the Home dashboard and Nutrition Tracker. Bento Grid for Explore feed.
layout.radius: rounded-2xl for surfaces, rounded-full for interactive chips/pills.
layout.navigation: Mobile-first Bottom Navigation Bar (fixed bottom-0, glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60). Desktop can use a side nav or top sticky header.

components.cards: Subtle 1px border. Dark mode: border-[#262626] bg-[#121217]. No muddy shadows, use crisp borders.
components.buttons: Category-specific color buttons. Flat solid background with rounded-full. Hover state: lighter hue and slight lift (-translate-y-1).
components.hero_overlays: Max bg-black/40 to let food photography shine. Use gradient overlays (from-black/70 via-black/40 to-transparent) instead of flat blankets.
components.charts: Shadcn charts or Recharts for Nutrition Tracker macros.
components.tabs: Shadcn tabs, customized with h-auto and category-colored active states.

motion.page_transitions: framer-motion fade-in and slide-up for seamless mobile-app feel.

image_urls.description: Fitness meal prep on black tray

accessibility: WCAG AA compliant. All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='home-tab-button'). Use focus:ring-2 and focus:outline-none.
instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize the React application with Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI primitives, and React Router.
Implement a theme provider to support Dark (default) and Light modes.
Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for headings and 'Satoshi' for body text. Install via @fontsource or Google Fonts.
Build a mobile-first layout featuring a fixed Bottom Navigation Bar for the 5 tabs: Home, Explore, Meal Plan, Track, Profile.
Develop the Home Dashboard using a bento grid structure containing 3 category tiles (Healthcare, Fitness, Cultural). Color code them using the defined category colors.
Create the Recipe Detail Page highlighting food photography with gradient hero overlays (max bg-black/40 opacity) to ensure readability of the overlaying text.
Implement the Weekly Meal Planner (calendar view) and Nutrition Tracker (using macro progress charts).
Ensure the Premium upgrade gate locks or blurs premium features and prominently displays the Gold (#FFD166) theme.
Apply data-testid to every interactive component for testing.
Avoid generic sans-serif fonts for headings and ensure all forms/dialogs use customized Shadcn components.
